name: Essence Lost
source:
One week before graduation from school the hero falls asleep at the part and upon waking up gets a feeling that he lost something. A hunger for love rises in him and he won't waste this week.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
毕业前一周，主人公在派对上睡着，醒来后感觉自己失去了某些东西。对爱情的饥渴在心中升起，他不会浪费这最后一周。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
